verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the eight-ad deliverable package, 45-second duration, and 16 format-specific finished files; these are concrete video-artifact specifications.
The client replaces the eight-video package with a three-video pilot before expansion; removing the obsolete total video and finished-file counts preserves consistent deliverable state.
The client specifies five additional video artifacts contingent on successful testing of the initial three-video pilot, a concrete deliverable-expansion acceptance condition.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Once this video has been delivered, we will place the order for 5 more videos.

ambiguity.description: It is unclear whether the five-video follow-on is now triggered merely by delivery of a single video or the pilot package, rather than by successful testing of all three initial videos.
